1.consolidated_definition: Gallo certero en su tiro con las espuelas. Véase espueloso. Existen los derivados espuelero y espueloso aplicados al gallo que es diestro con las espuelas.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Gallant cock with a sure shot in his spur-fighting. See spur-some. There are the derivatives spurrier and spursome applied to the rooster that is dexterous with his spurs.
